paper.title: SPELL: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for Evolving Long-Context Language Models
paper.central_claim: SPELL以同一策略扮演questioner/responder/verifier，通过无人工QA标签的自博弈联合GRPO，持续合成课程并提升长上下文推理，在16K训练后泛化到100K评测。

evidence.quote:
, the removal of the format penalty and the grounding filter degrades the average score by 1.1 and 1.0 points, respectively.
The format penalty keeps the question well-formed, and the grounding filter prevents the generation of hallucinated questions.
The largest drops come from disabling the update mechanism and the history memory: freezing the questioner lowers the average score by 4.6, and removing history memory lowers it by 2.9. The declines appear across DocMath, Frames, LB-MQA, and LB-V2, which indicates that these components have a broad impact rather than task-specific effects.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告history removal与冻结questioner的消融；这些效果终点是训练后模型，不是冻结权重下部署保留组件的收益。

signatures.information: 无标签文档、生成QA、八组回应及验证投票、CEM和一致性信号
signatures.operation: 采样QA→grounding过滤→回应→验证多数票→角色奖励→均衡采样联合GRPO
signatures.output: 更新后的统一策略参数
conditions: 规则一致性限制verifier自我认同
questioner难度目标约50% responder成功率
signatures.feedback: responder正确率/多数判断；questioner高斯难度奖励；verifier多数一致奖励
signatures.selection_rule: 格式/grounding过滤、可解QA历史、验证一致性筛选
signatures.selection_data: 训练文档聚类与本轮rollouts，不是外部部署测试反馈
signatures.persistence: 模型checkpoint权重；另有每文档簇L=3的近期可解QA缓冲
signatures.later_use: 更新策略在下一训练轮执行所有角色；历史被questioner读取；最终评测trained responder
signatures.claimed_effect: 标签自由课程提升长上下文QA与长度泛化
signatures.failure_boundary: 共享模型自判可能自我强化；历史不是部署侧经验指导；论文并未验证反馈演化prompt/tool/workflow

claims.text: SPELL以同一策略扮演questioner/responder/verifier，通过无人工QA标签的自博弈联合GRPO，持续合成课程并提升长上下文推理，在16K训练后泛化到100K评测。
claims.setting: 多模型、六个长文QA基准、16K训练及16K/100K评测
claims.baseline_control: base、RLVR与长上下文训练方法；Table 2去history/冻结questioner等
claims.selection_vs_test: 课程rollouts为训练信号，独立基准为训练后模型测量
claims.result_denominator: 作者报告12模型与6基准；例如Qwen2.5-7B平均26.7→40.6（16K）；并非本席复现
counterevidence: 没有部署侧冻结权重的retained-harness对照
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者报告权重训练与训练课程消融收益，不能外推为本雷达范围内非权重闭环。

claims.text: history memory使课程生成更有效
claims.selection_vs_test: 历史用于训练合成，终点评价训练模型
claims.result_denominator: 全文报告memory-off下降2.9，冻结questioner下降4.6
counterevidence: 未把QA缓冲作为部署侧可保留改进对象单独评价
claims.allowed_conclusion: 承认训练历史有因果消融；不等于非权重harness留存收益。

G.reason: out_of_scope (rubric A3; EVIDENCE.md excludes self-play fine-tuning). Independently checked: one policy plays questioner/responder/verifier and all role samples supervise that single policy via GRPO (opus:O01, opus:O02); every reported result is a trained checkpoint. The history memory is a per-document-cluster training-time queue that conditions the questioner during rollouts (opus:O03); it is ablated (w/o History Memory) but its effect is measured only through the trained model, and it is not a non-weight component retained and read by a deployed system. Not scored; null is not a zero-quality rating.
